text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My biggest opponent today is Mejiro<n>Bright. She
stands before me as a<n>representative of the Mejiro
family,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Races are lonesome and isolating<n>things! The truly
strong take on races<n>without relying on their
families. So<n>who's going to shine the brightest
today? That's right! Me!
